# client-project-review

**Trigger:** Review contracted deliverables and remaining work in an external client engagement.

**Role:** Chief of Staff → Operations + QA

**Required inputs:** Agreed scope, repo, latest client decisions and evidence

**Tools:** GitHub, contract/docs when present, authorized communication records. Only use actually available and approved capabilities.

**Procedure:** Map each deliverable to implementation, test evidence and deployment confirmation separately; identify blockers, change requests, owner and next milestone.

**Output:** Client delivery checklist and factual gap report.

**Success criterion:** No unsupported delivery claim; founder approves communication and commitments.

**Guardrails:** Before work, verify code and related issues. Give priority, next action, dependency, acceptance criteria, evidence links and test status. Code changes require founder approval for authorized scope; deployments, merges, emails, spending, production security changes require separate explicit approval. Never expose credentials or sensitive user records. A skill file does not autonomously execute any step.
